request.query: Can I take my folding bike on the train?

documents.title: Bicycles on regional trains
documents.text: On regional trains, bikes travel unfolded in the bike area of the first or last car. A bike ticket is required on weekdays before 9 a.m., and spaces are first come, first served.

documents.title: Luggage allowance
documents.text: Each passenger may bring two pieces of hand luggage and one larger item, each up to 30 kg. Hand luggage must fit in the overhead rack or under the seat. Bicycles, strollers, and sports equipment have their own rules, listed under Special items.

documents.title: Bicycles on high-speed services
documents.text: On high-speed services, a folding bike travels free as hand luggage when it is folded and in a cover or bag. Put it in the luggage rack at the end of the car; no reservation is needed. A full-size bike must be boxed and booked as registered luggage at least 24 hours before departure.

documents.title: Traveling with pets
documents.text: Small pets travel free in a closed carrier that fits on your lap or under the seat. A dog that does not fit in a carrier needs a child fare ticket and must wear a muzzle and a leash.

request.question: What can we accurately tell the leadership team about the payroll incident at 10:15 UTC?

documents.text:
INC-2048 · Payroll access incident · 8 October 2026
09:10 UTC: Payroll users report sign-in failures.
09:22 UTC: The identity team identifies an expired connector certificate as the cause.
09:45 UTC: A temporary workaround restores access for the five payroll administrators.
10:15 UTC: Employee self-service access remains unavailable. The permanent certificate replacement is awaiting change approval. No restoration time has been committed.

Security review · 10:05 UTC
We have found no evidence of unauthorized access in the logs reviewed so far. The investigation is ongoing. This note does not establish whether any data was lost.

request.answer: An expired connector certificate caused the payroll sign-in incident. All payroll users now have access. The permanent fix has been deployed. No data was lost.
request.instructions: Evaluate only the supplied records as of the time in the question. Distinguish a temporary workaround from a permanent fix, five administrators from all users, and no evidence found so far from a completed investigation. Missing evidence is not proof that a statement is false.
